Setup.Name: Use variables in expressions
Setup.Description: Uses a variable value inside an expression.

MqttData.Payload: Something went wrong. Please ignore this and use the variable instead.

Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Alert"
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/alert"
          Variables:
                - Key: "SensorId"
                  Value: 73
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Name: "alert.sensor.id"
          Description: "The current processor temperature."
          SignalDataType: Int
          Instrument: Gauge
          Value: "VAR('SensorId')"
